translations.translatedText: # Sunday 29.12.2019 (radio)
Finns are flying more than before. Almost everyone eats too much salt. The My Kanta service is being renewed. Many Australians want to ban Sydney's fireworks.
## Climate change and air travel
![Finnair's Airbus 350 aircraft lands at Helsinki-Vantaa airport on a summer day.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10896145)
Open image viewer
Finnair's Airbus 350 aircraft lands at Helsinki-Vantaa airport. Photo: Esko Jämsä / AOP
First, news about climate change and air travel.

Air travel speeds up climate change. However, people are flying more than before. By the end of November, 24 million air journeys had been made in Finland. That is 5 million more air journeys than in the same period last year.
Finns still eat a lot of meat too. Last year a Finn ate an average of 80 kilos of meat. Beef and pork are eaten slightly less than before. Chicken is eaten more than before.
Eating meat also speeds up climate change.
## Too much salt is eaten
![Sea salt, tomato and bread.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11137022)
Open image viewer
Sea salt, tomato and bread. Photo: Jussi Nukari / Lehtikuva
Almost all Finns eat too much salt.
The guidance is that an adult may eat 5 grams of salt a day. In Finland, men eat almost 10 grams of salt a day and women 7 grams.
There is a lot of salt in meat and bread, for example. Many fish dishes also contain a lot of salt.
Salt must not be eaten in excess, because it is bad for health. Salt, for example, raises blood pressure.
## My Kanta is being renewed
![A doctor listens to a patient's lungs with a stethoscope.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11114364)
Open image viewer

Health information of under-18s will appear to parents in My Kanta only after the doctor's assessment. The Patient Act requires that a child's ability to decide on their own treatment is always established. Photo: Jessica Edén/Yle
The My Kanta service will change a little next year. My Kanta is an online service where you can see information about your own health written by a doctor.
Next year a father or mother can also look at a child's health information in My Kanta. The child's information will be visible to parents until the child turns 18.
There is also another change to My Kanta.

Next year, for example, the information of a sick father or mother can be viewed in My Kanta. For this there must be permission, that is, a power of attorney. The power of attorney is made online. This will be possible only from the summer.
## Sydney's New Year fireworks
![Fireworks in the sky over Sydney.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10576829)
Open image viewer
Fireworks in the sky over Sydney in 2018. Photo: Brendan Esposito / EPA
In Australia more than 260,000 people demand that the New Year's fireworks in the city of Sydney be cancelled.
They say that the fireworks are too expensive. Last year, 3.6 million euros was spent on fireworks. People think the money should be used to put out fires. There are big bush fires in Australia.
Sydney is in the state of New South Wales. From Monday, no fire at all may be lit there. Near Sydney it may be as hot as 44 degrees on New Year's Eve.
